application.name: Velodyne VLP-16 Lidar Viewer
application.description: Receive Velodyne VLP-16 packets over UDP or from a pcap recording, build a rolling point cloud on the GPU, and view it from a fixed top-down or chase camera on Holoscan 5.x.

changelog.2.0.0: Holoscan 5.x port: UDP, pcap, and synthetic sources; fixed top-down and chase views rendered on the GPU; DAQIRI removed.
changelog.1.1: Port UDP receive path to DAQIRI

hardware.name: Velodyne VLP-16
hardware.description: Live mode only: a VLP-16 sensor sending data packets to UDP port 2368.

data.name: VLP-16 pcap recording
data.description: Replay mode only: any classic-pcap VLP-16 recording, such as the VeloView samples, or a synthetic one from make_pcap.py.

live.description: Receive packets from a VLP-16 on UDP port 2368 (all interfaces) and display them.

live-close.description: Receive live VLP-16 UDP packets with a close chase view centered on the sensor for nearby testing.

replay.description: Replay a VLP-16 pcap recording at its recorded pace and display it.

synthetic.description: Display an endless synthetic VLP-16 sweep of a simple room; no sensor or data needed.

ci.description: Finite headless run on synthetic packets; needs a GPU but no sensor, data, or display.
